Florida visitor fishing license planner

Florida visitors aged 16 or older usually need a fishing license, even for catch and release. A properly licensed saltwater charter or pier can cover that outing. Use this planner to separate those trips from beach, private-boat, and freshwater fishing before you choose your license.
